title: npm-cache (CLI v11 documentation)
abstract: The configured npm cache contains an opaque content-addressed _cacache holding HTTP request and package-related data. Integrity is checked on insertion/extraction; verify checks and garbage collects. clean generally unnecessary except space reclamation, requires --force. Cache is not a persistent reliable package store. Windows default LocalAppData/npm-cache; configuration may change location.
supports: 用途与缓存设计及工具；不证明任意同名文件是npm生成的，不保证具体缓存副本永远可以重新获得。

title: Pro Git, 2nd edition: 10.2 Git Objects
abstract: Git objects form a content-addressable object database under .git/objects; blobs represent stored content, trees organize entries and commits describe snapshots/history. Object files are repository data, not a generic disposable download cache.
supports: 对象库用途；单独删除对象可能破坏仓库完整性是基于数据结构的保守推论，不保证远程含全部本地数据。

title: git-gc — Cleanup unnecessary files and optimize the local repository
abstract: git gc runs repository housekeeping and optimizes object storage. The documentation describes retention of referenced objects and dangers of pruning while another process writes to the repository. Use repository-aware maintenance instead of manually deleting arbitrary object files.
supports: 仓库内维护工具与并发写入风险；不构成对用户具体仓库删除安全的确认。

title: RAFT: Adapting Language Model to Domain Specific RAG
abstract: Retrieval augmented fine-tuning trains domain-specific open-book answering with relevant and distractor documents, including document citations and chain-of-thought style targets. The paper reports evaluations on PubMed, HotpotQA and Gorilla. This experiment borrows distractor exposure only and does not reproduce RAFT, its reasoning targets, tasks or reported accuracy.
supports: 检索资料混合相关/干扰训练的研究动机；本轮拒猜负例和表达干预是本项目方案，不能归为RAFT原结论。
